reviewNotes: Reviewed enlarged frames 7-14 and 15-22 (1-based). The previously conspicuous pommel extending along the wrist armor is resolved by fixed scale, finger grip placement and near-horizontal high angles.
No increased occlusion: every finger polygon is identical to draft1. No body frame was changed, replaced, or dropped.
Underlying body source has soft hand detail during early preparation (frames 4-5); retained without repainting.
This is a revised review asset, not a published or game-bound replacement.
